info.name: SmoovOps API
info.description: Every endpoint callable with a Personal API Token (PAT), auto-generated from the backend's route definitions — see https://smoovops.com/doc/api-access for how to generate a token, and https://smoovops.com/doc/api-reference for full field documentation. Auth/newsletter/webhook/token-management endpoints are intentionally not included here since none of them accept a PAT (they're public, third-party-signed, or blocked for token management specifically) — see this repository's README for details.
